prompt: Title screen appears; start a game, finish a puzzle, restart, and confirm the save resumes.
Change display mode, VSync, frame cap, and anti-aliasing; confirm stable rebuilds and persistence.
Minimize for 30 seconds, restore, alt-tab, resize, and use available monitor/DPI changes without a hang or input burst.
Play at least ten minutes with keyboard/mouse and controller; exercise level transitions, previews, loading, and animation.
For an installer build: verify uninstall retains saves and upgrade retains saves/settings. Otherwise mark skipped.
